== Course of events ==

Confined in a small room with her arms and legs extending impossibly out through the window and chimney, Alice encounters an astonishing misunderstanding. She is mistaken for the Rabbit's housemaid, and as though it were the most natural thing in Wonderland's topsy-turvy world, she consents to the task—to retrieve the missing items from his house. This agreement, struck in the midst of her impossible predicament, becomes a curious turning point in her adventures in this bewildering realm.
